## 更新内容

FolderRewind 1.8.1 是针对 1.8.0 启动问题的紧急修复版本。

- 修复旧配置中的 `zh_CN` / `en_US` 导致程序在创建窗口前退出的问题。
- 历史语言值会自动迁移为 `zh-CN` / `en-US`；未知值会安全回退为系统语言。
- 即使 Windows 拒绝应用语言覆盖，程序也会回退系统语言并继续启动。

如果 1.8.0 无法启动，请先关闭程序并备份 `config.json`，再将 `GlobalSettings.Language` 改为 `"system"`、`"zh-CN"` 或 `"en-US"`。请勿删除整个配置文件。

Store/MSIX 配置位置：
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\<PackageFamilyName>\LocalState\FolderRewind\config.json`

MSI 配置位置：
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\FolderRewind\config.json`

---

Official website & documentation: https://folderrewind.top

It is recommended to download this software from the [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9nwsdgxdqws4). **Do not install the Store version and the sideloaded version from this page at the same time.**

## What's Changed

FolderRewind 1.8.1 is an emergency hotfix for the v1.8.0 startup failure.

- Fixes a crash before window creation when an existing configuration contains `zh_CN` or `en_US`.
- Automatically migrates legacy language values to `zh-CN` or `en-US`; unknown values safely fall back to the system language.
- If Windows rejects a language override, the app falls back to the system language and continues starting.

If v1.8.0 cannot start, close the app and back up `config.json`, then change `GlobalSettings.Language` to `"system"`, `"zh-CN"`, or `"en-US"`. Do not delete the entire configuration file.

Store/MSIX configuration:
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\<PackageFamilyName>\LocalState\FolderRewind\config.json`

MSI configuration:
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\FolderRewind\config.json`
